title: Relative Hom identity from the locally closed counit normalization
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, c:S→V a closed immersion, v:V→T open, T Noetherian, and c≫v quasi-compact. Use the actual comparison coordinates [def-sf-locally-closed-comparison-coordinates]. Fix ambient closed adjoints a, a bound hb on J_et of bounded constructible targets, and a natural isomorphism gamma:C_S J_et→J_proet C_T with Delta_(J_et M) F_proet(gamma_M) epsilon_proet=C_T(epsilon_et). Put r:J_et≅X for the specified counit-compatible closure exceptional adjoint identification, and theta_M=gamma_M^(-1) C_S(r_M X(eta_M)), with eta the site-comparison unit [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. For every normalized FixedComparisonClassAdjunction B [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], every bounded-below etale-origin K, every bounded constructible M [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] with C_T M bounded below, every bounded-below representative L and origin isomorphism w:C_S L≅K, and every h:F_proet K→C_T M, the pro-etale transpose of h followed by theta_M equals B’s Hom bijection applied to the literal map F_closure(w^(-1)) followed by the named closure compact-support comparison, C_T(q_et,L^(-1)), Delta_L, F_proet(w), and h. Here q_et:F_et≅R(c≫v)_! is the specified etale support identification. No invertibility of theta is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Lift Delta_L F_proet(w) h uniquely through C_T at the bounded-below target to h0:F_et L→M. If g0 is its etale transpose, naturality of Delta at g0 and the assumed counit identity identify the pro-etale transpose of F_proet(w)h with C_S(g0) gamma_M. Cancelling gamma against its inverse gives C_S(g0 r_M X(eta_M)). Apply the normalization axiom of B to the map q_et,L^(-1) h0 eta_M. Naturality of eta and counit-compatible right-adjoint uniqueness identify its successive transposes with the same expression. Finally B’s source naturality and the ordinary adjunction’s source naturality applied to w^(-1) give the asserted equation for K and the given witness. Inverse cancellation shows this works for every witness and every normalized B.
